research_question: In adults, what is the effect of remote or Web 2.0 physical activity interventions, compared with placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention, on continuous self-reported physical activity assessed at 12 months?
treatment_label: Remote or Web 2.0 physical activity intervention
control_label: Placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention
outcome_description: Continuous self-reported physical activity at the assessment closest to 12 months. Extract raw arm-level mean, standard deviation, and sample size for each randomized group. Eligible measures may include self-reported activity duration, frequency, volume, energy expenditure, or questionnaire scores. Exclude cardiorespiratory fitness, device-measured activity, dichotomous outcomes such as meeting activity guidelines, and 24-month follow-up data. If multiple eligible assessments are available, select the one closest to 12 months.
positive_direction: A positive SMD means that adults assigned to a remote or Web 2.0 intervention reported greater physical activity at 12 months than adults assigned to placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention; reverse-code measures if higher scores indicate less activity.
search_queries: remote physical activity intervention randomized trial 12 month self reported outcome
web based physical activity program controlled trial 12 month questionnaire
Web 2.0 exercise intervention RCT long term self reported physical activity
inclusion_criteria: Original randomized controlled trials enrolling adults and evaluating a remote, online, web-based, mobile, telehealth, social-media, or other Web 2.0 intervention intended to increase physical activity.
Trials containing an eligible placebo, no-intervention, wait-list, usual-information, attention, or minimal-intervention comparison group.

Trials reporting a continuous self-reported physical activity measure at, or sufficiently near, 12 months with arm-level mean, SD, and N or other quantitative information from which these values or an SMD can be obtained.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical RCT, including protocols, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, theoretical papers, and non-randomized studies.
No comparison between the remote/Web 2.0 intervention and a placebo, no-intervention, or minimal-intervention control condition.

No eligible quantitative continuous self-reported physical activity data capable of producing an effect size (e.g., arm-level means, SDs, and Ns, or convertible t/F statistics); this includes studies reporting only dichotomous activity outcomes, cardiorespiratory fitness, device-measured outcomes, or only 24-month data.
Completely unrelated to remote or Web 2.0 physical activity interventions in adults.
moderators_to_extract: Intervention delivery mode and technology type
Population characteristics, including mean age, sex/gender distribution, and clinical versus general population
Self-report instrument and physical activity construct or unit
Exact timing of the assessment selected as closest to 12 months
effect_size_note: Pool continuous outcomes as standardized mean differences because studies may use different instruments and units. Prefer raw randomized-arm mean, SD, and N at the eligible assessment closest to 12 months; align score direction so higher values consistently represent more physical activity. Apply an appropriate small-sample correction if the analysis software's SMD implementation does so, document all conversions or imputations, and account for multi-arm trials to avoid double-counting shared controls.
